answers.core: It can be worked around, but it seems like such a common design pattern that I think newer devs would benefit from it coming in the base engine. Seeing this option will make someone think about why they would want editor only visuals and create a more readable game in terms of developement. Editor only visuals is like the code comments of the 3D scene.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around, but implementing it requires adding scripts to every scene needing to be hidden or a large list to maintain that potentially could result in unwanted visuals making it into the main game.
